events.title: Storming of the Bastille
events.descr: Parisians take the royal fortress-prison on 14 July: the Revolution reaches the streets.

events.title: French monarchy abolished
events.descr: The National Convention abolishes the monarchy on 21 September 1792 and proclaims the Republic.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_start: Abolition of the French monarchy, 21 September 1792

events.title: Hundred Days
events.descr: Napoleon returns from Elba and rules again until Waterloo; months long, so shown as an event until dates can carry months.

events.title: July Revolution
events.descr: Charles X is overthrown; Louis Philippe becomes King of the French.

events.title: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire
events.descr: Francis II lays down the imperial crown on 6 August 1806.

events.title: German Confederation founded
events.descr: The Congress of Vienna creates a league of 39 German states.

events.title: German revolutions of 1848–49
events.descr: The Frankfurt Parliament tries to unite Germany under a constitution and fails.

events.title: Austro-Prussian War
events.descr: Prussia defeats Austria; the Peace of Prague dissolves the German Confederation.

events.title: German Empire proclaimed
events.descr: Wilhelm I is proclaimed German Emperor at Versailles on 18 January 1871.

events.title: German Revolution
events.descr: Wilhelm II abdicates; a republic is proclaimed and the German monarchies fall.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Abdication of Wilhelm II and republic proclaimed, 9 November 1918

events.title: Berlin Wall
events.descr: Built from 13 August 1961; opened on 9 November 1989.

events.title: Serbian Revolution
events.descr: Uprisings against Ottoman rule that end in an autonomous Principality of Serbia.

events.title: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes created
events.descr: Serbia and the South Slav lands of Austria-Hungary unite on 1 December 1918.

events.title: Axis invasion of Yugoslavia
events.descr: Germany, Italy and Hungary invade on 6 April 1941; the country is partitioned.

events.title: Yugoslav Wars
events.descr: Wars of independence and ethnic conflict as Yugoslavia breaks up.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event9: Start of the Yugoslav Wars, 27 June 1991

events.title: Federal Republic of Yugoslavia proclaimed
events.descr: Serbia and Montenegro form a new federation on 27 April 1992; the socialist federation is gone.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Disintegrated (FR Yugoslavia is proclaimed by Serbia and Montenegro), 27 April 1992

events.title: Montenegro independent; the State Union ends
events.descr: Montenegro leaves on 3 June 2006; Serbia declares itself the successor on 5 June.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Independence of Serbia, 5 June 2006
